weekend_note: Showers arrive this weekend: roughly a 20% chance Saturday afternoon (up to 40% with storms Saturday night) and showers likely Sunday, about 60%, with breezy east winds. Saturday morning looks like the best window for Taste of the Beach (free festival, 10 AM to 4 PM), the Palafox Halloween Market and Boo at the Zoo. Indoor picks: Rocky Horror at Pensacola Little Theatre, the Victorian Seance at Barkley House, and Ice Flyers hockey Sunday at 4:05 PM. The fair's outdoor concerts, including The Lacs Saturday night, carry the most rain risk. Isaias recovery is still affecting some events, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: City park and facility closures continue after Isaias
news.summary: The city updated its list of open, closed and limited-hours parks on Oct 29 and asks residents to stay off playgrounds until they are inspected.

news.title: FEMA individual assistance approved for Escambia and seven other counties
news.summary: Federal aid for housing, repairs and other storm needs was announced Oct 29 after the earlier public-assistance approval. Applications go through DisasterAssistance.gov, but the link was not active yet in the report.

news.title: FEMA public assistance approved for Northwest Florida after Isaias
news.summary: Public assistance money is flowing to local governments, with Pensacola reporting about $25 million in damage to city facilities. Aid for individual residents is still under review.

news.title: Bayview Senior Center storm resource center closes Oct 30

news.title: Debris removal costs and recycling restart

news.title: Pelican opens on W Nine Mile Road

news.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair runs through Nov 1
news.summary: The fair opened on schedule despite storm damage at the grounds; organizers said canceling was not feasible because the ride company had later commitments.

news.title: A&E Fabrics and Crafts to close after storm damage
news.summary: The 1954 store on New Warrington Road is closing for good after roof damage and plans to retire.

news.title: TSA PreCheck enrollment at Pensacola airport Nov 3 to 6
news.summary: Daily enrollment 9 AM to noon and 1 to 5 PM; the fee is $76.75 for five years.

coverage_note: Updated early Saturday, Oct 31. Read this run: the NWS Pensacola forecast issued Oct 30 (Nov 6 and 7 lows and the Nov 7 rain chance are my estimates, and some rain chances are the night-period figure), Local Pulse's weekend guide dated Oct 29, PensacolaBeach.com's November events page, City of Pensacola news posts and Must Do Pensacola's Maynard's Donuts article. NorthEscambia.com pages would not load, so no Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment listings were added; north county coverage is thin. Visit Pensacola, the Saenger, Downtown Pensacola and the team sites were not opened, so Saenger shows and later-November items are carried over and not reconfirmed. Restaurant statuses are unchanged apart from the Maynard's addition, and the Oct 30 TSA, FEMA, Pelican, fair and A&E news items are carried over from earlier reads.
